messages.author: d8c6173cafa065da
messages.subject: genotyping errors
parts:
Hi Karl, 

I am working with an F2 population to make a genetic map following your manual and ASMap, but I get huge LGs (my map is covering around 5000 cM), and it looks weird. 

I tried to check if I have a genotyping error following the manual, using the cross-file used to build the last genetic map (I have attached a pdf with the results). Do you think it could be better to perform the genotyping error analysis with the first cross (with raw data), before deleting these genotypes with errors?. Or do you think I can´t build a genetic map with this data? 

I would appreciate your help, 

Best, 

Alicia

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] genotyping errors
parts:
I don't think I can provide any useful advice with the information provided.

I would spend too much time looking for individual genotyping errors or trying to estimate the genotyping error rate. Both are difficult or impossible in advance of having a confident genetic map.

I would focus mainly on omitting bad samples and setting aside badly behaved markers. A key question is whether the linkage groups are huge because of a few large intervals or if there's an overall map expansion.

karl
